# ValueSense (https://valuesense.io/)

> Hedge fund-quality analytics platform empowering investors with powerful insights and beautiful simplicity. Invest like Hedge Funds - Insights & Visuals.

## Website

- https://valuesense.io: Main site and access point.

## About Us

Value Sense is a stock analysis platform for investors. Through the platform, you'll uncover undervalued stocks with intrinsic valuation, earnings report, and value investing tools to beat the market.

## What We Do (Features)

- Stock fundamentals & Company specific KPI data (https://valuesense.io/): Stock analysis based on fundamental indicators, including intrinsic value analysis, financials and KPIs, growth, profitability, health, capital allocation, momentum, earnings, comparison analysis, estimates, dividends, price prediction, and investor relations.
- Stock Heatmap (https://valuesense.io/heatmap): Building a stock heatmap with filters by exchanges, industries, and metrics (return, intrinsic value, ratings).
- Stock screener (https://valuesense.io/stock-screener): stock screener with the ability to filter by multiple metrics, multiples, and ratios, including intrinsic value to identify undervalued stocks. The screener also automatically builds a stock heatmap and provides backtesting for your custom screener.
- Stock charting (https://valuesense.io/stock-charting): advanced stock charting that allows you to create charts for any company using any metrics, multiples, company-specific KPIs, and ratios.
- Stock ideas (https://valuesense.io/ideas): curated stock ideas including Undervalued stocks right now, Undervalued growth stocks, Undervalued dividend stocks, Magnificent 7 stocks, Warren Buffett Portfolio, High ROIC stocks, Low P/E stocks, Companies with low debt, and more.
- Watchlists (https://valuesense.io/workspace/watchlists): Personal Workspace at Value Sense is your command center for investment research. Create unlimited stock watchlists, Save your best screeners, Build your personal chart library with full editing
- Intrinsic value tools (https://valuesense.io/intrinsic-value-tools): Custom 10+ intrinsic value calculators, including reverse DCF, Earnings Growth Model, Peter Lynch charts, Discount rate, DCF value calculator, Relative value, Earnings power value, Peter Lynch Fair Value, Ben Graham fair value and more.
- Earnings calendar (https://valuesense.io/earnings-calendar): Stock earnings calendar wit hcustom filtres like market cap, quality rating, intrinsic value, revenue growth, ROIC, P/E and dividend yield.
